neighbours.label: making evidence public under pressure: the disclosure verb after 'refuse/decline/challenge … to' (reticence to speak, refused to produce, challenge anyone to bring forth)
fire: The manufacturer has long declined to disclose its safety test results.
Critics dared the agency to make its internal emails public.
The author never agreed to show the original manuscripts to scholars.
Officials were unwilling to open their records to independent auditors.
The startup's reluctance to reveal how its battery works fueled doubts.
He challenged the minister to publish the full contract.
The lab has refused to share its raw data with other researchers.
Investors demanded that the firm release its audited accounts.
quiet: The manufacturer has long declined to lower its prices.
Critics dared the agency to cut its budget in half.
The author never agreed to travel abroad for book tours.
Officials were unwilling to change the parade route.
The startup's reluctance to hire older engineers drew criticism.
He challenged the minister to a game of chess.
The lab has refused to move to the new building.
Investors demanded that the firm cut its expenses.
